name: pattern-waves

frames.best_why: Large halftone folds fill the frame with bright raised ridges and deep dark valleys.

tagline: A halftone dot surface ripples and shines like draped silk.
summary: A full-screen field of tiny dots that rises and folds like fabric, with bright specular bands sliding over the crests. Moving the pointer sends ripples across the surface.
appearance: Tiny white dots on black form a fine halftone screen that swells into diagonal folds, like cloth held up to a light. Bright ridges of denser dots catch the highlight while the valleys sink into darkness.
behaviour: The folds drift and reshape continuously, sliding diagonal highlights across the dot field. Moving the pointer sends a ripple through the surface, and clicking bursts it outward.
use_when: A hero or section wants a monochrome, textured backdrop that reads as fabric and responds to the pointer.
avoid_when: Dense dots and dark valleys are hard on low-resolution screens, and the WebGL loop needs a sized parent.
customise: Preset, pattern, wave, spacing, mark size, depth, light, shine, contrast, speed, scale, direction, colours, opacity, fade, characters, cursor size and strength, intro and paused are props.
weight_why: A multi-pass WebGL shader draws a full-screen dot field with ripples every frame.

a11y.note: Decorative and aria-hidden; reduced motion freezes the waves and disables the cursor ripples.

issues: Frame 1 catches the intro while the dot field is still nearly flat and dim.
polish_why: Convincing silk-like dots and highlights; the intro frame is flat and the effect is subtle.
